# A level under construction of any of the target's buildings here: the rule waits (pp_lprof_st 103). Else a
# standing one grows, highest tier first, while its next level pays back within the limit; where none stands,
# the cheapest that can be built here starts. Market access tries the logistics buildings in the plan's order,
# standing or not. Each candidate that fails ranks its reason in pp_lprof_fail (pp_lprof_finish turns it into
# the rule's state).

		limit = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_levels_under_construction > 0 OR = { building_type = building_type:brewery_mill building_type = building_type:brewery_manufactory building_type = building_type:beer_workshop building_type = building_type:brewery } } }
		set_variable = { name = pp_lprof_st value = 103 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_level > 0 OR = { building_type = building_type:brewery_mill building_type = building_type:brewery_manufactory building_type = building_type:beer_workshop building_type = building_type:brewery } } }
		pp_lprof_expand = { type = brewery_mill demand = mill_construction cat = mill ipl = 0.11 }
		pp_lprof_expand = { type = brewery_manufactory demand = manufactory_construction cat = std ipl = 0.11 }
		pp_lprof_expand = { type = beer_workshop demand = workshop_construction cat = std ipl = 0.11 }
		pp_lprof_expand = { type = brewery demand = guild_construction cat = std ipl = 0.34 }
	}
	else = {
		pp_lprof_start = { type = brewery_mill demand = mill_construction cat = mill ipl = 0.11 }
		pp_lprof_start = { type = brewery_manufactory demand = manufactory_construction cat = std ipl = 0.11 }
		pp_lprof_start = { type = beer_workshop demand = workshop_construction cat = std ipl = 0.11 }
		pp_lprof_start = { type = brewery demand = guild_construction cat = std ipl = 0.34 }
		pp_lprof_start_pick = yes
	}
}

		pp_lprof_start = { type = theater demand = theater_construction cat = std ipl = 0 }
		pp_lprof_start = { type = university demand = university_construction cat = std ipl = 0 }
		pp_lprof_start_pick = yes
	}
}

pp_lprof_t_naval_category = {
	if = {
		limit = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_levels_under_construction > 0 OR = { building_type = building_type:naval_base building_type = building_type:grand_shipyard building_type = building_type:shipyard building_type = building_type:dry_dock building_type = building_type:dock building_type = building_type:protected_harbor building_type = building_type:wharf } } }
		set_variable = { name = pp_lprof_st value = 103 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_level > 0 OR = { building_type = building_type:naval_base building_type = building_type:grand_shipyard building_type = building_type:shipyard building_type = building_type:dry_dock building_type = building_type:dock building_type = building_type:protected_harbor building_type = building_type:wharf } } }
		pp_lprof_expand = { type = naval_base demand = port_building_construction cat = port ipl = 0 }
		pp_lprof_expand = { type = grand_shipyard demand = port_building_construction cat = port ipl = 0 }
		pp_lprof_expand = { type = shipyard demand = port_building_construction cat = port ipl = 0 }
		pp_lprof_expand = { type = dry_dock demand = port_building_construction cat = port ipl = 0 }
		pp_lprof_expand = { type = dock demand = port_building_construction cat = port ipl = 0 }
		pp_lprof_expand = { type = protected_harbor demand = port_building_construction cat = std ipl = 0 }
		pp_lprof_expand = { type = wharf demand = town_building_construction cat = std ipl = 0 }
	}
	else = {
		pp_lprof_start = { type = naval_base demand = port_building_construction cat = port ipl = 0 }
		pp_lprof_start = { type = grand_shipyard demand = port_building_construction cat = port ipl = 0 }
		pp_lprof_start = { type = shipyard demand = port_building_construction cat = port ipl = 0 }
		pp_lprof_start = { type = dry_dock demand = port_building_construction cat = port ipl = 0 }
		pp_lprof_start = { type = dock demand = port_building_construction cat = port ipl = 0 }
		pp_lprof_start = { type = protected_harbor demand = port_building_construction cat = std ipl = 0 }
		pp_lprof_start = { type = wharf demand = town_building_construction cat = std ipl = 0 }
		pp_lprof_start_pick = yes
	}
}

# Location scope: the building category stored in the country variable $v$ (a flag) -> its target.
pp_lprof_category_target = {
	switch = {
		trigger = scope:pp_cplan_country.var:$v$
		flag:trade_category = { pp_lprof_t_trade_category = yes }
		flag:government_category = { pp_lprof_t_government_category = yes }
		flag:military_category = { pp_lprof_t_military_category = yes }
		flag:defense_category = { pp_lprof_t_defense_category = yes }
		flag:religious_category = { pp_lprof_t_religious_category = yes }
		flag:cultural_category = { pp_lprof_t_cultural_category = yes }
		flag:naval_category = { pp_lprof_t_naval_category = yes }
		flag:infrastructure_category = { pp_lprof_t_infrastructure_category = yes }
	}
}

# Location scope (in scope:pp_cplan_country's list pp_lprof_locs, owned by it): the rules of its profile in order;
# the first rule that starts a construction ends the location for the month.
pp_lprof_location_rules = {
	scope:pp_cplan_country = { remove_variable = pp_cplan_hit }
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:pp_lprof > 100.5 var:pp_lprof < 101.5
			scope:pp_cplan_country = { has_variable = pp_lprof_1_on }
		}
		pp_lprof_rules = { k = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			var:pp_lprof > 101.5 var:pp_lprof < 102.5
			scope:pp_cplan_country = { has_variable = pp_lprof_2_on }
		}
		pp_lprof_rules = { k = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			var:pp_lprof > 102.5 var:pp_lprof < 103.5
			scope:pp_cplan_country = { has_variable = pp_lprof_3_on }
		}
		pp_lprof_rules = { k = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			var:pp_lprof > 103.5 var:pp_lprof < 104.5
			scope:pp_cplan_country = { has_variable = pp_lprof_4_on }
		}
		pp_lprof_rules = { k = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			var:pp_lprof > 104.5 var:pp_lprof < 105.5
			scope:pp_cplan_country = { has_variable = pp_lprof_5_on }
		}
		pp_lprof_rules = { k = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			var:pp_lprof > 105.5 var:pp_lprof < 106.5
			scope:pp_cplan_country = { has_variable = pp_lprof_6_on }
		}
		pp_lprof_rules = { k = 6 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			var:pp_lprof > 106.5 var:pp_lprof < 107.5
			scope:pp_cplan_country = { has_variable = pp_lprof_7_on }
		}
		pp_lprof_rules = { k = 7 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			var:pp_lprof > 107.5 var:pp_lprof < 108.5
			scope:pp_cplan_country = { has_variable = pp_lprof_8_on }
		}
		pp_lprof_rules = { k = 8 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			var:pp_lprof > 108.5 var:pp_lprof < 109.5
			scope:pp_cplan_country = { has_variable = pp_lprof_9_on }
		}
		pp_lprof_rules = { k = 9 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			var:pp_lprof > 109.5 var:pp_lprof < 110.5
			scope:pp_cplan_country = { has_variable = pp_lprof_10_on }
		}
		pp_lprof_rules = { k = 10 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			var:pp_lprof > 110.5 var:pp_lprof < 111.5
			scope:pp_cplan_country = { has_variable = pp_lprof_11_on }
		}
		pp_lprof_rules = { k = 11 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			var:pp_lprof > 111.5 var:pp_lprof < 112.5
			scope:pp_cplan_country = { has_variable = pp_lprof_12_on }
		}
		pp_lprof_rules = { k = 12 }
	}
	scope:pp_cplan_country = { remove_variable = pp_cplan_hit }
}

# Location scope: the rules of slot $k$.
pp_lprof_rules = {
	pp_lprof_rule = { k = $k$ r = 1 }
	pp_lprof_rule = { k = $k$ r = 2 }
	pp_lprof_rule = { k = $k$ r = 3 }
	pp_lprof_rule = { k = $k$ r = 4 }
	pp_lprof_rule = { k = $k$ r = 5 }
}

# ---- Edits (scripted GUIs in scripted_guis/pp_location_profiles.txt) ----

# Location scope (root): the profile scope:pp_slot (s1..sN, a slot that is on) or none. A profile replaces the
# location's own rules or hands off; refresh_map_colors redraws the badges.
pp_lprof_assign_do = {
	owner ?= { save_scope_as = pp_lprof_country }
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:pp_lprof_country }
		switch = {
			trigger = scope:pp_slot
			flag:none = { pp_lprof_unassign = yes }
			flag:s1 = {
				if = {
					limit = { scope:pp_lprof_country = { has_variable = pp_lprof_1_on } }
					pp_lprof_assign_to = { n = 101 }
				}
			}
			flag:s2 = {
				if = {
					limit = { scope:pp_lprof_country = { has_variable = pp_lprof_2_on } }
					pp_lprof_assign_to = { n = 102 }
				}
			}
			flag:s3 = {
				if = {
					limit = { scope:pp_lprof_country = { has_variable = pp_lprof_3_on } }
					pp_lprof_assign_to = { n = 103 }
				}
			}
			flag:s4 = {
				if = {
					limit = { scope:pp_lprof_country = { has_variable = pp_lprof_4_on } }
					pp_lprof_assign_to = { n = 104 }
				}
			}
			flag:s5 = {
				if = {
					limit = { scope:pp_lprof_country = { has_variable = pp_lprof_5_on } }
					pp_lprof_assign_to = { n = 105 }
				}
			}
			flag:s6 = {
				if = {
					limit = { scope:pp_lprof_country = { has_variable = pp_lprof_6_on } }
					pp_lprof_assign_to = { n = 106 }
				}
			}
			flag:s7 = {
				if = {
					limit = { scope:pp_lprof_country = { has_variable = pp_lprof_7_on } }
					pp_lprof_assign_to = { n = 107 }
				}
			}
			flag:s8 = {
				if = {
					limit = { scope:pp_lprof_country = { has_variable = pp_lprof_8_on } }
					pp_lprof_assign_to = { n = 108 }
				}
			}
			flag:s9 = {
				if = {
					limit = { scope:pp_lprof_country = { has_variable = pp_lprof_9_on } }
					pp_lprof_assign_to = { n = 109 }
				}
			}
			flag:s10 = {
				if = {
					limit = { scope:pp_lprof_country = { has_variable = pp_lprof_10_on } }
					pp_lprof_assign_to = { n = 110 }
				}
			}
			flag:s11 = {
				if = {
					limit = { scope:pp_lprof_country = { has_variable = pp_lprof_11_on } }
					pp_lprof_assign_to = { n = 111 }
				}
			}
			flag:s12 = {
				if = {
					limit = { scope:pp_lprof_country = { has_variable = pp_lprof_12_on } }
					pp_lprof_assign_to = { n = 112 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	refresh_map_colors = yes
}

# Country scope: the icon or a rule target (scope:pp_field) of slot $k$ = the item scope:pp_key.
pp_lprof_set_slot = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_lprof_$k$_on }
		switch = {
			trigger = scope:pp_field
			flag:icon = { pp_lprof_set_target = { g = pp_lprof_$k$_ig c = pp_lprof_$k$_ic } }
			flag:r1 = { pp_lprof_set_target = { g = pp_lprof_$k$_r1_g c = pp_lprof_$k$_r1_c } }
			flag:r2 = { pp_lprof_set_target = { g = pp_lprof_$k$_r2_g c = pp_lprof_$k$_r2_c } }
			flag:r3 = { pp_lprof_set_target = { g = pp_lprof_$k$_r3_g c = pp_lprof_$k$_r3_c } }
			flag:r4 = { pp_lprof_set_target = { g = pp_lprof_$k$_r4_g c = pp_lprof_$k$_r4_c } }
			flag:r5 = { pp_lprof_set_target = { g = pp_lprof_$k$_r5_g c = pp_lprof_$k$_r5_c } }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope: steps the payback limit $var$ (years + 100; unset = any) through [location_profiles] payback_steps
# (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 10, 15, 20, 30, 40, 50) in the direction scope:pp_dir; up from the last step = any, down from
# any = the last step, down from the first stays.
pp_lprof_pb_step = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:pp_dir = flag:up }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = $var$ }
			if = { limit = { var:$var$ < 100.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 101 } }
			else_if = { limit = { var:$var$ < 101.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 102 } }
			else_if = { limit = { var:$var$ < 102.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 103 } }
			else_if = { limit = { var:$var$ < 103.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 104 } }
			else_if = { limit = { var:$var$ < 104.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 105 } }
			else_if = { limit = { var:$var$ < 106.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 107 } }
			else_if = { limit = { var:$var$ < 109.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 110 } }
			else_if = { limit = { var:$var$ < 114.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 115 } }
			else_if = { limit = { var:$var$ < 119.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 120 } }
			else_if = { limit = { var:$var$ < 129.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 130 } }
			else_if = { limit = { var:$var$ < 139.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 140 } }
			else_if = { limit = { var:$var$ < 149.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 150 } }
			else = { remove_variable = $var$ }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = $var$ } }
			set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 150 }
		}
		else_if = { limit = { var:$var$ > 150.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 150 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$var$ > 140.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 140 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$var$ > 130.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 130 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$var$ > 120.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 120 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$var$ > 115.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 115 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$var$ > 110.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 110 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$var$ > 107.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 107 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$var$ > 105.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 105 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$var$ > 104.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 104 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$var$ > 103.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 103 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$var$ > 102.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 102 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:$var$ > 101.5 } set_variable = { name = $var$ value = 101 } }
	}
}

# Country scope: the payback limit of rule scope:pp_field (r1..rN) of slot $k$.
pp_lprof_payback_slot = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_lprof_$k$_on }
		switch = {
			trigger = scope:pp_field
			flag:r1 = { pp_lprof_pb_step = { var = pp_lprof_$k$_r1_pb } }
			flag:r2 = { pp_lprof_pb_step = { var = pp_lprof_$k$_r2_pb } }
			flag:r3 = { pp_lprof_pb_step = { var = pp_lprof_$k$_r3_pb } }
			flag:r4 = { pp_lprof_pb_step = { var = pp_lprof_$k$_r4_pb } }
			flag:r5 = { pp_lprof_pb_step = { var = pp_lprof_$k$_r5_pb } }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: steps a rule's payback limit (scripted GUI pp_lprof_payback).
pp_lprof_payback_do = {
	switch = {
		trigger = scope:pp_slot
		flag:s1 = { pp_lprof_payback_slot = { k = 1 } }
		flag:s2 = { pp_lprof_payback_slot = { k = 2 } }
		flag:s3 = { pp_lprof_payback_slot = { k = 3 } }
		flag:s4 = { pp_lprof_payback_slot = { k = 4 } }
		flag:s5 = { pp_lprof_payback_slot = { k = 5 } }
		flag:s6 = { pp_lprof_payback_slot = { k = 6 } }
		flag:s7 = { pp_lprof_payback_slot = { k = 7 } }
		flag:s8 = { pp_lprof_payback_slot = { k = 8 } }
		flag:s9 = { pp_lprof_payback_slot = { k = 9 } }
		flag:s10 = { pp_lprof_payback_slot = { k = 10 } }
		flag:s11 = { pp_lprof_payback_slot = { k = 11 } }
		flag:s12 = { pp_lprof_payback_slot = { k = 12 } }
	}
}

# Country scope: empties rule scope:pp_field of slot $k$ (var:pp_lprof between $lo$ and $hi$ in its locations).
pp_lprof_rule_clear_slot = {
	switch = {
		trigger = scope:pp_field
		flag:r1 = {
			remove_variable = pp_lprof_$k$_r1_g
			remove_variable = pp_lprof_$k$_r1_c
			remove_variable = pp_lprof_$k$_r1_pb
			every_in_list = {
				variable = pp_lprof_locs
				limit = { has_variable = pp_lprof var:pp_lprof > $lo$ var:pp_lprof < $hi$ }
				remove_variable = pp_lprof_r1_st
			}
		}
		flag:r2 = {
			remove_variable = pp_lprof_$k$_r2_g
			remove_variable = pp_lprof_$k$_r2_c
			remove_variable = pp_lprof_$k$_r2_pb
			every_in_list = {
				variable = pp_lprof_locs
				limit = { has_variable = pp_lprof var:pp_lprof > $lo$ var:pp_lprof < $hi$ }
				remove_variable = pp_lprof_r2_st
			}
		}
		flag:r3 = {
			remove_variable = pp_lprof_$k$_r3_g
			remove_variable = pp_lprof_$k$_r3_c
			remove_variable = pp_lprof_$k$_r3_pb
			every_in_list = {
				variable = pp_lprof_locs
				limit = { has_variable = pp_lprof var:pp_lprof > $lo$ var:pp_lprof < $hi$ }
				remove_variable = pp_lprof_r3_st
			}
		}
		flag:r4 = {
			remove_variable = pp_lprof_$k$_r4_g
			remove_variable = pp_lprof_$k$_r4_c
			remove_variable = pp_lprof_$k$_r4_pb
			every_in_list = {
				variable = pp_lprof_locs
				limit = { has_variable = pp_lprof var:pp_lprof > $lo$ var:pp_lprof < $hi$ }
				remove_variable = pp_lprof_r4_st
			}
		}
		flag:r5 = {
			remove_variable = pp_lprof_$k$_r5_g
			remove_variable = pp_lprof_$k$_r5_c
			remove_variable = pp_lprof_$k$_r5_pb
			every_in_list = {
				variable = pp_lprof_locs
				limit = { has_variable = pp_lprof var:pp_lprof > $lo$ var:pp_lprof < $hi$ }
				remove_variable = pp_lprof_r5_st
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: empties a rule (scripted GUI pp_lprof_rule_clear).
pp_lprof_rule_clear_do = {
	switch = {
		trigger = scope:pp_slot
		flag:s1 = { pp_lprof_rule_clear_slot = { k = 1 lo = 100.5 hi = 101.5 } }
		flag:s2 = { pp_lprof_rule_clear_slot = { k = 2 lo = 101.5 hi = 102.5 } }
		flag:s3 = { pp_lprof_rule_clear_slot = { k = 3 lo = 102.5 hi = 103.5 } }
		flag:s4 = { pp_lprof_rule_clear_slot = { k = 4 lo = 103.5 hi = 104.5 } }
		flag:s5 = { pp_lprof_rule_clear_slot = { k = 5 lo = 104.5 hi = 105.5 } }
		flag:s6 = { pp_lprof_rule_clear_slot = { k = 6 lo = 105.5 hi = 106.5 } }
		flag:s7 = { pp_lprof_rule_clear_slot = { k = 7 lo = 106.5 hi = 107.5 } }
		flag:s8 = { pp_lprof_rule_clear_slot = { k = 8 lo = 107.5 hi = 108.5 } }
		flag:s9 = { pp_lprof_rule_clear_slot = { k = 9 lo = 108.5 hi = 109.5 } }
		flag:s10 = { pp_lprof_rule_clear_slot = { k = 10 lo = 109.5 hi = 110.5 } }
		flag:s11 = { pp_lprof_rule_clear_slot = { k = 11 lo = 110.5 hi = 111.5 } }
		flag:s12 = { pp_lprof_rule_clear_slot = { k = 12 lo = 111.5 hi = 112.5 } }
	}
}

# Country scope: swaps rule scope:pp_field of slot $k$ with its neighbour in the direction scope:pp_dir.
pp_lprof_rule_move_slot = {
	switch = {
		trigger = scope:pp_field
		flag:r1 = {
			if = {
				limit = { scope:pp_dir = flag:down }
				pp_lprof_swap_rules = { k = $k$ a = 1 b = 2 lo = $lo$ hi = $hi$ }
			}
		}
		flag:r2 = {
			if = {
				limit = { scope:pp_dir = flag:up }
				pp_lprof_swap_rules = { k = $k$ a = 1 b = 2 lo = $lo$ hi = $hi$ }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:pp_dir = flag:down }
				pp_lprof_swap_rules = { k = $k$ a = 2 b = 3 lo = $lo$ hi = $hi$ }
			}
		}
		flag:r3 = {
			if = {
				limit = { scope:pp_dir = flag:up }
				pp_lprof_swap_rules = { k = $k$ a = 2 b = 3 lo = $lo$ hi = $hi$ }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:pp_dir = flag:down }
				pp_lprof_swap_rules = { k = $k$ a = 3 b = 4 lo = $lo$ hi = $hi$ }
			}
		}
		flag:r4 = {
			if = {
				limit = { scope:pp_dir = flag:up }
				pp_lprof_swap_rules = { k = $k$ a = 3 b = 4 lo = $lo$ hi = $hi$ }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:pp_dir = flag:down }
				pp_lprof_swap_rules = { k = $k$ a = 4 b = 5 lo = $lo$ hi = $hi$ }
			}
		}
		flag:r5 = {
			if = {
				limit = { scope:pp_dir = flag:up }
				pp_lprof_swap_rules = { k = $k$ a = 4 b = 5 lo = $lo$ hi = $hi$ }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: moves a rule up or down (scripted GUI pp_lprof_rule_move).
pp_lprof_rule_move_do = {
	switch = {
		trigger = scope:pp_slot
		flag:s1 = { pp_lprof_rule_move_slot = { k = 1 lo = 100.5 hi = 101.5 } }
		flag:s2 = { pp_lprof_rule_move_slot = { k = 2 lo = 101.5 hi = 102.5 } }
		flag:s3 = { pp_lprof_rule_move_slot = { k = 3 lo = 102.5 hi = 103.5 } }
		flag:s4 = { pp_lprof_rule_move_slot = { k = 4 lo = 103.5 hi = 104.5 } }
		flag:s5 = { pp_lprof_rule_move_slot = { k = 5 lo = 104.5 hi = 105.5 } }
		flag:s6 = { pp_lprof_rule_move_slot = { k = 6 lo = 105.5 hi = 106.5 } }
		flag:s7 = { pp_lprof_rule_move_slot = { k = 7 lo = 106.5 hi = 107.5 } }
		flag:s8 = { pp_lprof_rule_move_slot = { k = 8 lo = 107.5 hi = 108.5 } }
		flag:s9 = { pp_lprof_rule_move_slot = { k = 9 lo = 108.5 hi = 109.5 } }
		flag:s10 = { pp_lprof_rule_move_slot = { k = 10 lo = 109.5 hi = 110.5 } }
		flag:s11 = { pp_lprof_rule_move_slot = { k = 11 lo = 110.5 hi = 111.5 } }
		flag:s12 = { pp_lprof_rule_move_slot = { k = 12 lo = 111.5 hi = 112.5 } }
	}
}

# Country scope: clears slot scope:pp_slot and takes it off every location (scripted GUI pp_lprof_delete).
pp_lprof_delete_do = {
	switch = {
		trigger = scope:pp_slot
		flag:s1 = { pp_lprof_delete_slot = { k = 1 lo = 100.5 hi = 101.5 } }
		flag:s2 = { pp_lprof_delete_slot = { k = 2 lo = 101.5 hi = 102.5 } }
		flag:s3 = { pp_lprof_delete_slot = { k = 3 lo = 102.5 hi = 103.5 } }
		flag:s4 = { pp_lprof_delete_slot = { k = 4 lo = 103.5 hi = 104.5 } }
		flag:s5 = { pp_lprof_delete_slot = { k = 5 lo = 104.5 hi = 105.5 } }
		flag:s6 = { pp_lprof_delete_slot = { k = 6 lo = 105.5 hi = 106.5 } }
		flag:s7 = { pp_lprof_delete_slot = { k = 7 lo = 106.5 hi = 107.5 } }
		flag:s8 = { pp_lprof_delete_slot = { k = 8 lo = 107.5 hi = 108.5 } }
		flag:s9 = { pp_lprof_delete_slot = { k = 9 lo = 108.5 hi = 109.5 } }
		flag:s10 = { pp_lprof_delete_slot = { k = 10 lo = 109.5 hi = 110.5 } }
		flag:s11 = { pp_lprof_delete_slot = { k = 11 lo = 110.5 hi = 111.5 } }
		flag:s12 = { pp_lprof_delete_slot = { k = 12 lo = 111.5 hi = 112.5 } }
	}
}

# Country scope: removes every rule of slot $k$.
pp_lprof_clear_rules = {
	remove_variable = pp_lprof_$k$_r1_g
	remove_variable = pp_lprof_$k$_r1_c
	remove_variable = pp_lprof_$k$_r1_pb
	remove_variable = pp_lprof_$k$_r2_g
	remove_variable = pp_lprof_$k$_r2_c
	remove_variable = pp_lprof_$k$_r2_pb
	remove_variable = pp_lprof_$k$_r3_g
	remove_variable = pp_lprof_$k$_r3_c
	remove_variable = pp_lprof_$k$_r3_pb
	remove_variable = pp_lprof_$k$_r4_g
	remove_variable = pp_lprof_$k$_r4_c
	remove_variable = pp_lprof_$k$_r4_pb
	remove_variable = pp_lprof_$k$_r5_g
	remove_variable = pp_lprof_$k$_r5_c
	remove_variable = pp_lprof_$k$_r5_pb
}

# Location scope: removes the rule states.
pp_lprof_clear_states = {
	remove_variable = pp_lprof_r1_st
	remove_variable = pp_lprof_r2_st
	remove_variable = pp_lprof_r3_st
	remove_variable = pp_lprof_r4_st
	remove_variable = pp_lprof_r5_st
}

# Any scope: the category flag in the variable $from$ -> $to$ (removed when $from$ holds none).
pp_lprof_copy_c = {
	remove_variable = $to$
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = $from$ }
		switch = {
			trigger = var:$from$
			flag:trade_category = { set_variable = { name = $to$ value = flag:trade_category } }
			flag:government_category = { set_variable = { name = $to$ value = flag:government_category } }
			flag:military_category = { set_variable = { name = $to$ value = flag:military_category } }
			flag:defense_category = { set_variable = { name = $to$ value = flag:defense_category } }
			flag:religious_category = { set_variable = { name = $to$ value = flag:religious_category } }
			flag:cultural_category = { set_variable = { name = $to$ value = flag:cultural_category } }
			flag:naval_category = { set_variable = { name = $to$ value = flag:naval_category } }
			flag:infrastructure_category = { set_variable = { name = $to$ value = flag:infrastructure_category } }
		}
	}
}
